description: This file defines the IPCReceiver class, a server-side component that listens for inter-process communication requests over a socket, handles incoming messages, and responds accordingly. It includes socket management, request handling, and threading logic.

classes.name: IPCReceiver
classes.description: A server class that listens for IPC requests over a socket, manages request handling threads, and communicates with a handler to process requests.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable to process individual socket requests, decode messages, invoke handler, and send responses.

methods.name: IPCReceiver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server with a specified port and thread pool.

methods.name: getPortNumber
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on.

methods.name: startReceiveThread
methods.description: Starts the server socket and listening thread for incoming IPC requests.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Closes the server socket, shuts down thread pool, and cancels the task.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Overrides Task.start(), throws exception to prevent direct invocation.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Overrides Task.cancel(), throws exception to prevent direct invocation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main loop accepting incoming socket connections and delegating request processing.
